label: Breath of the Wild in Cemu with Crementif's BetterVR
notes: The picture settings live in BetterVR's own Graphics pack inside Cemu (Options, Graphic packs), so they are 'ask' settings: The Optimizer names the step, the person (or a Menu-o-matiC route) picks it, and `python -m engine.cli set` records it. Foveated rendering is in BetterVR_settings.ini. Preset names are from BetterVR's BreathOfTheWild_Graphics rules.txt as installed 2026-11-21; Tefa ran 2x on a 72 Hz headset then.

knobs.label: VR Resolution Multiplier
knobs.where: Cemu: Options, Graphic packs, BetterVR's Graphics pack, 'VR Resolution Multiplier' (then restart the game)
